rfcspec.catalogue.Digest.description: A SHA-256 digest in lower-case hexadecimal.
rfcspec.catalogue.Digest.title: Digest

rfcspec.catalogue.ExplorerIndex.description: Every RFC of the bulk summary as the RFC explorer's front page lists and filters it, one file generated from the bulk summary and the profiles' locks.

rfcs.description: Every summary row, in number order.

rfcspec.catalogue.ExplorerIndex.title: ExplorerIndex

rfcspec.catalogue.ExplorerIndexRow.description: One Rfc of the bulk summary as the RFC explorer's list filters it: its index metadata, the source format read, its requirement counts by level and the profiles whose lock holds it. No SHA-256 and no requirement text; the RFC view shows the rest.

profiles.description: The name of each profile under profiles/ whose rfcspec.lock holds the RFC, in name order.

rfcspec.catalogue.ExplorerIndexRow.title: ExplorerIndexRow

rfcspec.catalogue.ExplorerReference.description: One Reference of an RFC read from RFCXML as the RFC explorer shows it; the citing RFC is the one that lists it.

section.description: The anchor of the citing section, absent where the xref lies outside every section.

target_rfc.description: The cited RFC's number; it may name an RFC without a row in the bulk summary.

rfcspec.catalogue.ExplorerReference.title: ExplorerReference

rfcspec.catalogue.ExplorerRfc.description: One Rfc of the bulk summary as the RFC explorer shows it: its index metadata, the source read, its requirement counts by level, in total and by section, its update graph and its References. No requirement text.
rfcspec.catalogue.ExplorerRfc.title: ExplorerRfc

rfcspec.catalogue.ExplorerSection.description: One section of an RFC as the RFC explorer shows it (a projection of Section and the requirements it owns): its number and, read from RFCXML, its anchor, its title and its mechanically extracted requirements counted by BCP 14 level. The one entry without a number counts the requirements outside every numbered section; a level with none is not listed.

anchor.description: The section anchor read from RFCXML; the text reader records none.

number.description: The section number (5.2, A.1), absent for the entry counting requirements outside every numbered section.

title.description: The section heading without its number, absent where no heading was read.

rfcspec.catalogue.ExplorerSection.title: ExplorerSection

rfcspec.catalogue.ExplorerShard.description: The RFCs of one hundred RFC numbers as the RFC explorer reads them, one file per hundred that holds a summary row, generated from the bulk summary and its section sidecar.

index_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the rfc-index.xml the bulk summary was read from.

not_in_index.description: The RFC numbers the shard's update graphs and References name that have no row in the bulk summary, so the explorer shows them without a link.

rfcs.description: Every summary row of the range, in number order.

start.description: The first number of the hundred, a multiple of 100.

rfcspec.catalogue.ExplorerShard.title: ExplorerShard

rfcspec.catalogue.LevelCount.description: How many of an RFC's mechanically extracted requirements have one BCP 14 level, under the extractor version the bulk summary records; a level with none is not listed.
rfcspec.catalogue.LevelCount.title: LevelCount

rfcspec.catalogue.ReferenceKind.description: Whether the cited document is listed among the citing RFC's normative or informative references.
rfcspec.catalogue.ReferenceKind.title: ReferenceKind

rfcspec.catalogue.RfcNumber.description: The RFC Editor's number of the document.
rfcspec.catalogue.RfcNumber.title: RfcNumber

rfcspec.catalogue.SourceFormat.description: The format the RFC was read from, RFCXML v3 where the index lists it, plain text otherwise.
rfcspec.catalogue.SourceFormat.title: SourceFormat

rfcspec.catalogue.YearMonth.description: A month written YYYY-MM; the index gives month and year.
rfcspec.catalogue.YearMonth.title: YearMonth
